articles.title: IAF’s 40 Sukhoi fighters now armed with BrahMos missiles: Aerospace co-director
articles.summary: Approximately 40 Indian Air Force (IAF) Su-30MKI fighter jets have been successfully integrated with the advanced BrahMos supersonic cruise missiles. This significant upgrade, confirmed by BrahMos Aerospace, substantially enhances the IAF's long-range precision strike capability and strategic deterrence. The integration transforms the Su-30MKI into a formidable weapon platform, bolstering India's air power and regional security.

articles.title: Lies, Damn Lies, and Climate Stats
articles.summary: Dr. Robert Vislocky highlights how climate change debates across social media platforms are frequently plagued by persistent, flawed arguments. His analysis likely dissects these common logical fallacies and misconceptions. This critical perspective is invaluable for SSB aspirants, fostering the ability to evaluate complex global issues with scientific rigor and critical thinking, which is essential for informed discussions and interviews.
